### **Notes:**
1. **Status Definitions**:
   - **Operational**: Currently generating power.
   - **Under construction**: Actively being built.
   - **Planned**: Approved but not yet under construction.
   - **Retired**: Decommissioned or no longer operational.

2. **Sources**:
   - **EVN (Electricity of Vietnam)**: [www.evn.com.vn](https://www.evn.com.vn) (official reports and project updates).
   - **MOIT (Ministry of Industry and Trade)**: [www.moit.gov.vn](https://moit.gov.vn) (energy planning documents).

3. **Future Projects**:
   - Many LNG-to-power projects are in the planning phase, with CODs subject to FID (Final Investment Decision) and infrastructure development.

4. **Retirements**:
   - Older units (e.g., Cam Pha 1 Unit 1) may be retired as newer plants come online.

5. **Data Gaps**:
   - Some smaller or older plants (< 30 MWe) are excluded. For a comprehensive list, consult EVN’s annual reports or MOIT’s power development plans.

For the most up-to-date information, refer to:
- [EVN’s Annual Reports](https://www.evn.com.vn)
- [MOIT’s Power Development Plan VIII (PDP8)](https://moit.gov.vn)

| Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | COD | Owner/Developer | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes |

- Fuel: Coal / Domestic gas / Imported LNG
- Technology (coal): Subcritical / Supercritical / USC
- Technology (gas): CCGT / OCGT
- Status: Approved / Planned / Operational / Under construction / Suspended / Cancelled / Retired

- COD: Actual or expected commercial operation date
